intelligence.title: Intelligence
intelligence.subtitle: Memory, tasks, and knowledge graph
intelligence.drop_formats: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, EPUB, HTML, MD, TXT, and more
intelligence.doc_placeholder: Paste your document here — Markdown, plain text, meeting notes, research, anything…
intelligence.rebuild_desc: Re-ingests all sources and rebuilds the summary tree. Runs automatically every 6 h.
intelligence.no_docs_hint: Paste text or import a file above to feed Youma's knowledge base.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure AI providers, models, and local options.
settings.thinking_desc: Phrases shown during the model's thinking phase.
settings.thinking_phrases_help: Each phrase is shown with a typewriter effect during thinking.
settings.thinking_phrases_placeholder: e.g. Thinking, Just a moment, Processing...
settings.thinking_phrases_hint: Separate phrases with a comma. Accents, apostrophes and special characters are all supported.
settings.thinking_default_desc: Claude-style default phrases — used when the Custom tab is empty.
settings.thinking_default_overridden: Not currently active: the Custom tab has saved phrases.
settings.thinking_custom_desc: Your personal phrases. When filled, completely replaces the Default tab. Clear to revert to Default.
settings.model_override_desc: Override the default model for your active provider (stored as YOUMA_MODEL).
settings.channels_desc: Connect Slack, Discord, Gmail and more
settings.notifications_desc: System events and AI activity alerts
settings.logo_desc: Custom image shown in the Home screen above the version string.
settings.logo_drop: Drop an image here or click to browse
settings.logo_invalid_type: Only SVG, JPEG, and PNG files are accepted.
settings.encrypted_desc: AES-256-GCM · machine-derived key · stored locally only
settings.local_storage_title: Your data stays on your device
settings.local_storage_desc: Conversations, memories, knowledge base, and inbox messages are stored in SQLite on this machine. API keys are encrypted before writing to {{file}}. Nothing is uploaded to any server except your AI provider when you send a message.
settings.reset_desc: Deletes all conversations, memories, tasks, knowledge base, and inbox. API keys are kept.
settings.reset_warning: This cannot be undone. Tap "Tap again to confirm" to proceed, or navigate away to cancel.
settings.about_desc: Local AI assistant — all data stored on your device
settings.openai_key_help: Priority 2 — uses gpt-4o by default. Also enables Whisper STT and OpenAI TTS.
settings.elevenlabs_key_help: Optional — high-quality TTS. Set TTS_PROVIDER=elevenlabs to activate.
settings.composio_key_help: Unlocks 118+ integrations (Gmail, GitHub, Notion, Slack, …). Get it at composio.dev.
settings.deepseek_key_help: Priority 3 — uses deepseek-chat by default. Get it at platform.deepseek.com.
settings.tts_provider_help: 'native' = system voice (free), 'elevenlabs' = ElevenLabs high quality (requires key), 'openai' = OpenAI nova voice (requires key).
settings.stt_lang_help: BCP-47 language tag for voice input.
settings.ollama_url_help: Used as fallback when no API key or CUSTOM_AI_URL is set. Requires Ollama running locally.
settings.ollama_model_help: Model to use with Ollama (e.g. llama3.2, mistral, phi3).
settings.custom_ai_url_help: Root URL of the OpenAI-compatible server (e.g. http://localhost:1234 for LM Studio). Takes priority over all other providers when set.
settings.custom_ai_key_help: Leave blank if your server does not require authentication (local servers like llama.cpp don't need one).
settings.custom_ai_model_help: Model identifier sent to your server. Can be a name (mistral-7b-instruct), a path (~/llm/models/model.gguf), or any string your server expects.
settings.emb_desc: Enable vector embeddings for semantic search over your knowledge base. Semantic search understands meaning, not just keywords — ideal for domain-specific documents. Requires an embedding model (local via Ollama or cloud via OpenAI/DeepSeek).
settings.custom_ai_desc: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: LM Studio, vLLM, Groq, Together AI, Mistral, etc. Priority 4 — used when no Anthropic/OpenAI/DeepSeek key is set.
settings.priority_custom_priority: Custom (URL + API Key both set) — highest priority
settings.priority_custom: Custom (URL only, no key — any OpenAI-compatible)
settings.priority_footer: Keys stored in {{file}} — never sent to third parties.

human.tap_to_start: Tap the mic to start a conversation.

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Enable or disable capabilities for your AI assistant
skills.desc_web_fetch: Fetch and read content from URLs

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.no_messages_hint: Connect Gmail, Slack, or Discord in the Channels tab.
inbox.select_message: Select a message to read it
inbox.encrypted_desc: All message bodies are encrypted at rest with your device key.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.recording_hint: Speak freely — transcript updates in real time
meetings.speaker_tag_hint: Tap a name to insert a speaker tag at the current point in the transcript (manual)
meetings.cal_no_event: No event found near this time. Check Composio → Google Calendar connection.

meetings_settings.defaults_desc: These values are pre-filled each time you start a new recording.
meetings_settings.auto_import_desc: Watch a folder and automatically transcribe + save any new audio files.
meetings_settings.diarize_desc: Automatically identifies who is speaking using local AI models (requires OpenAI key for transcription). ONNX models are downloaded on first use (~120 MB).
meetings_settings.diarize_feature_note: Note: also requires building with the 'diarize' feature enabled. Without it, speaker separation is inactive (transcription still works).
meetings_settings.share_desc: Pre-filled values used when sharing a meeting from the detail view. Leave blank to enter them each time.
meetings_settings.share_slack_help: Channel name without #. Requires Slack connected in Channels.
meetings_settings.share_github_help: Issues will be created here. Requires GitHub connected in Channels.
meetings_settings.share_jira_help: Alphanumeric project key (e.g. PROJ, DEV). Requires Jira connected in Channels.
meetings_settings.share_notion_help: Pages are created in the workspace root. Requires Notion connected in Channels. No extra config needed.

license.title: License
license.activate_desc: Enter your license key to activate Youma
license.server_url_help: Leave blank to use the default server. Only change if you have a private license server.
